text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock C after gains felt satisfying, but a gain versus my cost alone is not a reason to sell; I should also consider future prospects and portfolio balance.","Several sells in Stock B remind me not to trim a winner repeatedly just to lock in gains; I should decide on a clear reason and avoid letting loss aversion or gain-seeking drive the choice.","My account value moved around despite few trades, so I should focus on the whole portfolio and its risk, trade deliberately, and not react to every monthly change."]}
